name: etzhayyim-private-chain-contracts
description: Foundry project for chain 260425 contracts. The npm side exists only to pull prebuilt Safe v1.4.1 artifacts (JSON bytecode + ABI) — Safe's hardhat-compiled output works in our 0.8.23 toolchain via `vm.parseJsonBytes(...)` whereas re-compiling Safe sources hits stack-too-deep on the etzhayyim profile (Safe is pinned to solc 0.7.6, our etzhayyim contracts to 0.8.23). See script/DeploySafe.s.sol for the deploy path.
